description: This Java source file defines the SubscriptionActor class, which manages subscription command processing, stream translation, and event handling within an Akka actor system. It includes methods for starting/stopping subscriptions, handling timeouts, and converting the actor into a reactive stream subscriber.

classes.name: SubscriptionActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages streaming subscriptions, translating commands into stream operations and emitting subscription events. It handles request, cancel, timeout, and completion events, and can be wrapped as a reactive stream Subscriber.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration object for creating SubscriptionActor instances.

methods.name: asSubscriber
methods.description: Wraps the actor as a reactive streams Subscriber of JsonArray items.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleans up subscription on actor termination.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling behavior.

methods.name: createZombieBehavior
methods.description: Sets actor behavior to ignore incoming messages after cancellation or timeout.

methods.name: idleTimeout
methods.description: Handles actor timeout, cancels subscription, and emits failure.

methods.name: onSubscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription establishment, ensuring only one active subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCreated
methods.description: Creates a SubscriptionCreated event with current subscription ID and headers.

methods.name: setSenderAndDittoHeaders
methods.description: Updates sender ActorRef and DittoHeaders based on received command.

methods.name: requestSubscription
methods.description: Initiates demand request to the subscription if active; else stashes the request.

methods.name: cancelSubscription
methods.description: Cancels an active subscription or stashes if not started yet.

methods.name: subscriptionHasNext
methods.description: Forwards the event of next page items to the sender.

methods.name: subscriptionComplete
methods.description: Handles completion event, notifies sender, and transitions to zombie state.

methods.name: subscriptionFailed
methods.description: Handles failure event, notifies sender, and transitions to zombie state.

methods.name: becomeZombie
methods.description: Transitions actor to a zombie state where it ignores further messages, with timeout cleanup.

methods.name: getSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the actor's name as subscription ID.
